_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE airframe - replace every value with your design. Masses exclude payload and propulsion parts.
name: Illustrative Micro airframe

_clmax_source.basis: trimmed, ~8% static margin (CG ~0.36 m behind root LE), elevon up to 15 deg
_clmax_source.method: XFLR5 spanload (vutaz.xfl opps, alpha 0-11, extrapolated) vs XFoil section clmax (N9, by local Re); elevon increments from a vortex lattice incl. tip fins (matches XFLR5 CL_alpha within 2.5%, NP within 3 mm)
_clmax_source.assumed_elevons: y 0.26-0.72 m, 25% chord, 0.8 x thin-airfoil effectiveness; up-elevon lowers section clmax by 0.6 x its dcl0
_clmax_source.note: XFLR5 station at y=0.2195 m (kink) is a panelling spike and was excluded
